      :`<div class="empty">${ELOG.length?'この条件のミスはありません':'まだ記録はありません。英作文や英文解釈で「✍ AI添削」を使うと、ここにたまります（APIキーを入れて、アプリ内で添削した場合）'}</div>`}</section>`}
// ---------- 学習スケジュール ----------
let PLAN=LS.get('mt-plan',{end:{},start:{},daily:{},mode:{},base:{}});PLAN.end=PLAN.end||{};PLAN.start=PLAN.start||{};PLAN.daily=PLAN.daily||{};PLAN.mode=PLAN.mode||{};PLAN.base=PLAN.base||{};
const normalizeStudyCalendarState=value=>value&&typeof value==='object'&&!Array.isArray(value)?{
  open:value.open&&typeof value.open==='object'&&!Array.isArray(value.open)?value.open:{},
  month:value.month&&typeof value.month==='object'&&!Array.isArray(value.month)?value.month:{}
}:{open:{},month:{}};
let STCAL=normalizeStudyCalendarState(LS.get('mt-study-calendar-ui-v1',{open:{},month:{}}));
const PLAN_END_DEF='2027-01-01';function planDefaults(){if(PLAN.endset!=='2027-01-01'){D.tabs.forEach(x=>PLAN.end[x.id]=PLAN_END_DEF);PLAN.endset='2027-01-01';LS.set('mt-plan',PLAN)}}planDefaults();
const tabTally=ti=>{const c=[0,0,0,0];SECU[ti].forEach(us=>{const k=tally(us);for(let i=0;i<4;i++)c[i]+=k[i]});return c};
function planBase(){const td=ymd(new Date());if(!PLAN.base||PLAN.base.d!==td){PLAN.base={d:td,c:D.tabs.map((t,ti)=>tabTally(ti)[1])};LS.set('mt-plan',PLAN)}return PLAN.base}
const dateOrdinal=date=>{const [y,m,d]=date.split('-').map(Number);return Date.UTC(y,m-1,d)/864e5};
const dateSpan=(start,end)=>Math.round(dateOrdinal(end)-dateOrdinal(start))+1;
const addDays=(date,count)=>{const d=new Date(date+'T00:00:00');d.setDate(d.getDate()+count);return ymd(d)};
const dateLabel=date=>new Date(date+'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('ja-JP');
function planCalc(ti){const B=planBase(),t=D.tabs[ti],c=tabTally(ti),n=c[0]+c[1]+c[2]+c[3],done=c[1],base=B.c[ti]||0,today=Math.max(0,done-base),td=ymd(new Date());
  const mode=PLAN.mode[t.id]||'dates',start=PLAN.start[t.id]||td,end=PLAN.end[t.id]||'',days=end&&start<=end?dateSpan(start,end):null;
  const effectiveStart=start<td?td:start,availableDays=end&&end>=effectiveStart?dateSpan(effectiveStart,end):0;
  const remaining=Math.max(0,n-done),dateRemaining=Math.max(0,n-(start<=td?base:done)),dateGoal=availableDays?Math.ceil(dateRemaining/availableDays):null;
  const savedDaily=Number(PLAN.daily[t.id]),daily=Number.isFinite(savedDaily)&&savedDaily>0?savedDaily:(dateGoal||1);
  let goal=mode==='daily'?daily:dateGoal,msg='';
  if(mode==='dates'){
    if(!start||!end)msg='開始日と終了日を設定すると1日の個数が出ます';
    else if(days==null)msg='開始日と終了日を確認してください';
    else if(remaining===0)msg='完了 🎉';
    else if(availableDays<1)msg='終了日を過ぎています';
    else if(goal==null)msg='開始日と終了日を確認してください';
  }
  const projectedEnd=remaining===0?td:addDays(td,Math.ceil(remaining/daily)-1);
  return {t,n,done,today,mode,start,end,goal,daily,remaining,projectedEnd,msg}}
function planBox(ti){const p=planCalc(ti),pct=p.goal?Math.min(100,p.today/p.goal*100):0;
  return `<div class="bkplan"><div class="bpi"><div class="plm"><button class="${p.mode==='daily'?'on':''}" data-pmode="${p.t.id}:daily">1日の個数 → 終了日</button><button class="${p.mode==='dates'?'on':''}" data-pmode="${p.t.id}:dates">開始日＋終了日 → 1日の個数</button></div>
    ${p.mode==='daily'?`<label>1日当たり<input type="number" min="1" step="1" inputmode="numeric" data-pdaily="${p.t.id}" value="${p.daily}">個</label><span class="pldate">終了予定日：${dateLabel(p.projectedEnd)}</span>`:`<label>📅 開始日<input type="date" data-pstart="${p.t.id}" value="${esc(p.start)}"></label><label>📅 終了日<input type="date" data-pend="${p.t.id}" value="${esc(p.end)}"></label>`}</div>
    ${p.mode==='dates'&&p.goal==null?`<div class="plt">${p.msg}</div>`:p.remaining===0?`<div class="plt">完了 🎉</div>`:`<div class="plq"><b>1日 ${fmtN(p.goal)}個</b><span>${p.mode==='daily'?`終了予定日 ${dateLabel(p.projectedEnd)}`:`${dateLabel(p.start)}〜${dateLabel(p.end)}`}</span><span class="sp"></span><span>今日 ◎ ${fmtN(p.today)} / ${fmtN(p.goal)}${p.today>=p.goal?' 🎉':''}</span></div><div class="plbar"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div>`}</div>`}
function studyCalendarHTML(id){
  const month=STCAL.month[id]||ymd(new Date()).slice(0,7),[year,monthNum]=month.split('-').map(Number);
  const valid=Number.isInteger(year)&&Number.isInteger(monthNum)&&monthNum>=1&&monthNum<=12;
  const ym=valid?month:ymd(new Date()).slice(0,7),[y,m]=ym.split('-').map(Number),first=new Date(y,m-1,1),days=new Date(y,m,0).getDate();
  const daily=DAYACT.daily,countFor=day=>{const n=Number(daily[`${ym}-${String(day).padStart(2,'0')}`]?.[id])||0;return Number.isFinite(n)&&n>0?Math.floor(n):0};
  const total=Array.from({length:days},(_,i)=>countFor(i+1)).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  const active=Array.from({length:days},(_,i)=>countFor(i+1)).filter(n=>n>0).length;
  const today=ymd(new Date());
  const cells=Array((first.getDay()+6)%7).fill('<span></span>');
  for(let day=1;day<=days;day++){
    const date=`${ym}-${String(day).padStart(2,'0')}`,count=countFor(day);
    cells.push(`<div class="st-day${count?' active':''}${date===today?' today':''}" aria-label="${y}年${m}月${day}日 ${count}個"><span>${day}</span><b>${fmtN(count)}</b></div>`);
  }
  while(cells.length%7)cells.push('<span></span>');
  return `<button class="sb st-toggle" data-stcal="toggle:${id}" aria-expanded="${!!STCAL.open[id]}">📅 学習カレンダー　${y}年${m}月・${fmtN(total)}個</button>${STCAL.open[id]?`<div class="st-calendar"><div class="st-calhead"><button class="sb" data-stcal="prev:${id}" aria-label="前の月">‹</button><b>${y}年${m}月</b><button class="sb" data-stcal="next:${id}" aria-label="次の月">›</button><span class="st-calmeta">合計 ${fmtN(total)}個<br>${active}日取り組み</span></div><div class="st-week">${['月','火','水','木','金','土','日'].map(d=>`<span>${d}</span>`).join('')}</div><div class="st-month">${cells.join('')}</div><div class="st-legend">日付の下に、その日に取り組んだ項目数を表示します。同じ項目は1日1回まで記録します。</div></div>`:''}`;
}

let PR={scope:'sec',mode:'ans',mf:'all',pron:'on'};let PROPEN=false;
let PRON_VISIBLE=LS.get('mt-pronunciation-visible',true)!==false;
function prSec(s,test,mf,range){
  const ok=u=>mf==='all'||(mf==='w'?(MK[u]===2||MK[u]===3):String(MK[u]||0)===mf);
  const showPron=D.tabs[ST.tab].id==='word'&&PR.pron==='on';
  const lines=n=>'<div class="line"></div>'.repeat(n);
  const _si=D.tabs[ST.tab].secs.indexOf(s),_tn=NUMT.includes(D.tabs[ST.tab].id)&&_si>=0;let h=`<h2>${esc(_tn?(s.g&&s.g!=='A–Z'?s.g+' ':D.tabs[ST.tab].name+' ')+secL(ST.tab,_si):s.t)}</h2>`,tb='',inV=null,cnt=0;
  const flush=()=>{if(tb){h+=inV?`<table class="v"><colgroup><col class="cn"><col class="cf">${showPron?'<col class="cpn">':''}<col class="cm"><col class="cs"></colgroup><thead><tr><th>No.</th><th>英語</th>${showPron?'<th>発音（目安）</th>':''}<th>意味</th><th>出典</th></tr></thead><tbody>${tb}</tbody></table>`:`<div>${tb}</div>`;tb=''}};
  const mode=v=>{if(v!==inV){flush();inV=v}};
  const vrow=(e,no,fam)=>{cnt++;let form=e.p?plain(e.p):esc(e.f);
    const pronunciationKey=pronWord(e.f),pron=hasPron(pronunciationKey)?PRON_CACHE[pronunciationKey]:null;
    if(showPron&&!e.p&&pron&&!pron.error&&!pron.missing)form=stressedSpelling(e.f,pron.ipa);
    return `<tr class="${fam?'fam':''}"><td class="n">${no||''}</td><td class="f">${form}</td>${showPron?`<td class="pron">${pron&&!pron.error&&!pron.missing?kanaMarkup(pron.kana||'カナ変換不可'):'未取得'}</td>`:''}<td>${test?'':esc(e.m)+(e.alt&&e.alt.length?`<span class="alt">（${e.alt.map(([s,m])=>esc(SRC[s]||s)+'：'+esc(m)).join('／')}）</span>`:'')+(e.ex?`<div class="ex">${plain(e.ex[0])}　${esc(e.ex[1])}</div>`:'')+(e.note?`<div class="ex">注：${plain(e.note)}</div>`:'')}</td><td class="psrc">${e.src&&e.src.length?esc(ab(e.src)):''}</td></tr>`};
  const items=range?prRangeItems(s.items,range.a,range.b):s.items;
  items.forEach(it=>{
    switch(it.k){
      case 'h':if(mf==='all'){flush();h+=`<h3>${esc(it.t)}</h3>`}break;
      case 'fam':{mode(true);let first=true;it.s.forEach(x=>{if(!x.ref&&ok(x.u)){tb+=vrow(x,first?it.no:'',first);first=false}});break}
      case 'e':if(ok(it.u)){mode(true);tb+=vrow(it,it.no||'',false)}break;
      case 'txt':if(mf==='all'){mode(false);tb+=`<div class="txt">${fmt(it.x,test)}</div>`}break;
      case 'pu':if(mf==='all'){mode(false);tb+=`<div class="pu"><b>POINT ${esc(it.t||'')}</b><br>${fmt(it.x,test)}</div>`}break;
      case 'tbl':if(mf==='all'){mode(false);tb+=`<table class="t">${it.rows.map(r=>`<tr>${r.map(c=>`<td>${fmt(c,test)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</table>`}break;
      default:{
        if(!it.u||!ok(it.u))break;cnt++;
        if(it.k==='q'){mode(false);const ls=String(it.ex||'').split('\n');
          tb+=`<div class="b"><span class="no">No.${it.n}</span> <span class="src">${esc(it.src||'')}</span>${it.jp?`<div>${plain(it.jp)}</div>`:''}<div class="en">${it.full?fmt(it.full,test):plain(it.q)}</div>${it.c?`<div class="ch">${it.c.map((c,i)=>'①②③④⑤⑥'[i]+' '+esc(c)).join('　')}</div>`:''}${it.words?`<div class="ch">[ ${it.words.map(esc).join(' / ')} ]</div>`:''}
            ${test?(it.full?'':'<div>答え：</div>'):`${it.full?'':`<div>答え：<b class="r">${esc(it.ans)}</b></div>`}${it.tr&&it.tr!==it.jp?`<div class="tr">${esc(it.tr)}</div>`:''}<div class="ex">${fmt(ls.join('\n'))}</div>`}</div>`}
        else if(it.k==='gn'){mode(false);tb+=`<div class="b"><span class="no">No.${it.n}</span> <b>${esc(it.t)}</b><div class="en2">${fmt(it.c,test)}</div><ul>${(it.p||[]).map(p=>`<li>${fmt(p,test)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>${it.ex?`<div class="ex">${esc(it.ex[0])}　${test?'':esc(it.ex[1])}</div>`:''}${it.ng&&!test?`<div class="ex">${plain(it.ng)}</div>`:''}</div>`}
        else if(it.k==='cp'){mode(false);tb+=`<div class="b"><span class="no">${esc(SRC[it.src])} ${esc(it.no)}</span><div>${plain(it.jp)}</div>${test?lines(it.src==='p2'?8:2):`<div class="en">${fmt(it.en)}</div>${it.alt?`<div class="ex">別解：${esc(it.alt)}</div>`:''}${it.motto?`<div class="ex">★ ${plain(it.motto)}</div>`:''}${(it.pts||[]).map(p=>`<div class="ex"><b>${plain(p.h)}</b>：${(p.l||[]).map(l=>typeof l==='object'?plain(l.e)+' '+plain(l.j):plain(l.replace(/^>/,'→ '))).join(' ／ ')}</div>`).join('')}`}</div>`}
        else if(it.k==='st'){mode(false);tb+=`<div class="b"><span class="no">${esc(SRC[it.src])} ${esc(it.no)}</span><div class="en">${esc(it.en)}</div>${test?lines(2):`<div class="tr">和訳：${esc(it.yaku)}</div>${it.choku?`<div class="ex">直訳：${esc(it.choku)}</div>`:''}${it.svoc?`<div class="ex">${esc(it.svoc)}</div>`:''}${(it.pts||[]).map(p=>`<div class="ex">・${plain(p)}</div>`).join('')}`}</div>`}
        else if(it.k==='ex'){mode(false);tb+=`<div class="b"><span class="no">例文 ${it.no}</span> ${esc(it.t)}<div class="en">${plain(it.en)}</div>${test?lines(1):`<div class="tr">${esc(it.ja)}</div>`}</div>`}
        else if(it.k==='kp'){mode(true);const key=pronWord(it.f),pron=hasPron(key)?PRON_CACHE[key]:null;tb+=`<tr><td class="n"></td><td class="f">${esc(it.f)}</td>${showPron?`<td class="pron">${pron&&!pron.error&&!pron.missing?kanaMarkup(pron.kana||'カナ変換不可'):'未取得'}</td>`:''}<td><span class="alt">${esc(it.refs.join('、'))}</span></td><td></td></tr>`}
      }
    }
  });
  flush();return cnt?`<section>${h}</section>`:'';
}
function prSheet(){
  const t=D.tabs[ST.tab],s=t.secs[ST.sec];
  const bounds=prNumBounds(t,s);
  const opt=(k,v,l)=>`<button class="sb${PR[k]===v?' on':''}" data-pr="${k}:${v}">${l}</button>`;
  return `<div class="pov"><div class="psh"><h2>🖨 印刷</h2><div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--sub)">${esc(t.name)}｜${esc(s.t)}</div>
    <div class="k3">範囲</div><div class="opts">${opt('scope','sec','この範囲')}${s.g?opt('scope','grp','「'+esc(s.g)+'」全部'):''}${opt('scope','tab','「'+esc(t.name)+'」全部')}${bounds?opt('scope','num','番号で指定'):''}</div>
    ${PR.scope==='num'&&bounds?`<div class="prrange"><span>${esc(s.g||s.t)}（${bounds.min}〜${bounds.max}）</span><input type="number" min="${bounds.min}" max="${bounds.max}" step="1" inputmode="numeric" data-prnum="a" value="${esc(PR.a||'')}" placeholder="${bounds.min}" aria-label="開始番号">〜<input type="number" min="${bounds.min}" max="${bounds.max}" step="1" inputmode="numeric" data-prnum="b" value="${esc(PR.b||'')}" placeholder="${bounds.max}" aria-label="終了番号"></div>`:''}
    <div class="k3">内容</div><div class="opts">${opt('mode','ans','答えつき（見直し用）')}${opt('mode','test','答えを空欄（テスト用）')}</div>
    <div class="k3">印</div><div class="opts">${opt('mf','all','すべて')}${opt('mf','2','〇だけ')}${opt('mf','3','△だけ')}${opt('mf','w','○△だけ')}${opt('mf','0','未チェックだけ')}</div>
    ${t.id==='word'?`<div class="k3">発音</div><div class="opts">${opt('pron','on','カタカナ発音を印刷')}${opt('pron','off','カタカナ発音を印刷しない')}</div>`:''}
    <div class="acts"><button class="sb" data-a="prclose">閉じる</button><button class="pbtn" data-a="prgo">印刷する</button></div></div></div>`;
}
function prNumBounds(t,s){
  const ranges=t.secs.map((x,i)=>x.g===s.g?SR[ST.tab][i]:null).filter(Boolean);
  return ranges.length?{min:Math.min(...ranges.map(r=>r[0])),max:Math.max(...ranges.map(r=>r[1]))}:null;
}
function prRangeItems(items,a,b){
  const out=[];let pending=[];
  items.forEach(it=>{
    if(NUMK.has(it.k)){
      if(it._g>=a&&it._g<=b)out.push(...pending,it);
      pending=[];
    }else if(it.k==='h')pending=[it];
    else pending.push(it);
  });
  return out;
}
function doPrint(){
  const t=D.tabs[ST.tab],s=t.secs[ST.sec];
  let range=null;
  if(PR.scope==='num'){
    const bounds=prNumBounds(t,s);
    if(!bounds){alert('この範囲には番号がありません。');return}
    const a=PR.a==null||PR.a===''?bounds.min:Number(PR.a),b=PR.b==null||PR.b===''?bounds.max:Number(PR.b);
    if(!Number.isInteger(a)||!Number.isInteger(b)||a<bounds.min||b>bounds.max||a>b){alert(`番号は${bounds.min}〜${bounds.max}の範囲で、開始番号が終了番号以下になるよう指定してください。`);return}
    range={a,b};
  }
  const secs=PR.scope==='sec'?[s]:PR.scope==='grp'||PR.scope==='num'?t.secs.filter(x=>x.g===s.g):t.secs;
  const test=PR.mode==='test';
  const body=secs.map(x=>prSec(x,test,PR.mf,range)).join('');
  let el=document.getElementById('pr');if(!el){el=document.createElement('div');el.id='pr';document.body.appendChild(el)}
  el.innerHTML=`<h1>英語完全版　${esc(t.name)}（${test?'テスト用':'答えつき'}${range?`・番号${range.a}〜${range.b}`:''}${PR.mf!=='all'?'・'+{'2':'〇','3':'△','w':'○△','0':'未チェック'}[PR.mf]+'だけ':''}）</h1>`+(body||'<p>該当する項目がありません</p>');
  PROPEN=false;
  if(STANDALONE){draw(true);setTimeout(()=>window.print(),50);return}
  // inside the artifact viewer: open a separate print window (same method as 英語学習)
  const css=[...document.querySelectorAll('style')].map(x=>x.textContent).join('\n');
  const w=window.open('','_blank');
  if(!w){draw(true);alert('印刷用の画面を開けませんでした。ポップアップを許可してから、もう一度押してください。');return}
  w.document.write(`<!doctype html><html lang="ja"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>英語完全版 印刷</title><style>${css}\n#pr{display:block!important;box-sizing:border-box;padding:11mm 10mm 12mm;box-decoration-break:clone;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;background:#fff;color:#111}body{background:#fff}</style></head><body>${el.outerHTML}<script>window.onload=()=>setTimeout(()=>window.print(),400)<\/script></body></html>`);
  w.document.close();draw(true);
}

// ---------- quiz (4択) ----------
let QZ=null;
const isG=()=>['goho','gram'].includes(D.tabs[ST.tab].id);
function vPool(){const out=[];D.tabs[ST.tab].secs.forEach(s=>units(s.items).forEach(x=>{if(x.kind==='v'&&x.m)out.push(x)}));return out}
function buildQuiz(){
  let us=units(curItems()).filter(x=>x.kind==='v'&&x.m);
  us=us.filter(x=>mfOK(x.u));
  if(ST.shuf)for(let i=us.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[us[i],us[j]]=[us[j],us[i]]}
  QZ={deck:us,i:0,pick:null,opts:null,ok:0,ng:[]};
}
function qOpts(x){const pool=vPool(),rev=ST.dir==='j',val=y=>rev?(y.p?plain(y.p):esc(y.f)):esc(y.m);const seen=new Set([val(x)]);const o=[x];
  for(let k=0;k<60&&o.length<4;k++){const y=pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];const v=val(y);if(!seen.has(v)){seen.add(v);o.push(y)}}
  for(let i=o.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[o[i],o[j]]=[o[j],o[i]]}return o}
function quizHTML(){
  if(!QZ.deck.length)return `<div class="empty">この範囲にクイズにできる項目はありません</div>`;
  if(QZ.i>=QZ.deck.length)return `<div class="done"><h2>おつかれさま</h2><div style="color:var(--sub)">${QZ.deck.length}問中 ${QZ.ok}問正解</div><div class="res"><div><b style="color:var(--m1)">${QZ.ok}</b>正解</div><div><b style="color:var(--m3)">${QZ.ng.length}</b>まちがい</div></div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap">${QZ.ng.length?`<button class="pbtn" data-a="qweak">まちがえた${QZ.ng.length}問をもう一度</button>`:''}<button class="sb" data-a="qagain">もう一度</button></div></div>`;
  const x=QZ.deck[QZ.i];if(!QZ.opts)QZ.opts=qOpts(x);const rev=ST.dir==='j';
  const q=rev?`<div class="cm">${esc(x.m)}</div>`:`<div class="cw">${x.p?plain(x.p):esc(x.f)}</div>`;
  const val=y=>rev?(y.p?plain(y.p):esc(y.f)):esc(y.m);
  return `<div class="fcard" style="cursor:default;min-height:150px"><div class="cn">クイズ（${QZ.i+1}/${QZ.deck.length}）　正解 ${QZ.ok}</div><div style="margin:auto 0">${q}</div></div>
    <div class="qopts">${QZ.opts.map((y,i)=>`<button class="qo${QZ.pick!==null?(y.u===x.u?' ok':(i===QZ.pick?' ng':'')):''}" data-qo="${i}"${QZ.pick!==null?' disabled':''}>${val(y)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    ${QZ.pick!==null?`<div class="qres ${QZ.opts[QZ.pick].u===x.u?'good':'bad'}">${QZ.opts[QZ.pick].u===x.u?'正解！':'まちがい（△を付けました）'}</div>
    <div class="rate"><button class="r1" data-qg="1">◎ 覚えた</button><button class="r2" data-qg="2">○ あやしい</button><button class="r3" data-qg="3">△ まだ</button></div>
    <div class="cnav"><span></span><button class="pbtn" data-a="qnext">次へ ›</button></div>`:''}`;
}
// ---------- ドリル（英文法・語法の型を一覧で） ----------
let DORD={};
function drillHTML(){
  const T=D.tabs[ST.tab];const secs=ST.dsc==='all'?T.secs:[T.secs[ST.sec]];
  let rows=[];secs.forEach(s=>s.items.forEach(it=>{if(it.k==='e'&&it.p)rows.push(it)}));
  if(ST.shuf){const key=ST.tab+':'+ST.dsc+':'+ST.sec;if(!DORD[key]||DORD[key].length!==rows.length){const o=rows.map((_,i)=>i);for(let i=o.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[o[i],o[j]]=[o[j],o[i]]}DORD[key]=o}rows=DORD[key].map(i=>rows[i])}
  rows=rows.filter(it=>mfOK(it.u));
  let h=`<div class="dctl"><span class="seg"><button class="${ST.dsc==='sec'?'on':''}" data-dsc="sec">この範囲</button><button class="${ST.dsc==='all'?'on':''}" data-dsc="all">${esc(T.name)}すべて</button></span>
    <button class="sb" data-a="katachi">型を答える（カード）</button><span class="sp"></span><span class="pt" style="margin:0">${rows.length}個</span></div>`;
  if(!rows.length)return h+`<div class="empty">この条件の型はありません</div>`;
  return h+`<div class="grows">${rows.map((it,i)=>gRow(it,i+1)).join('')}</div>`;
}
// ---------- 記録の保存・読込 ----------
let CFG=false,CFGMSG='';
function cfgHTML(){const data=JSON.stringify({v:1,marks:MK,memo:MEMO,miss:MISS,hist:HIST,study:DAYACT,essay:ESS,corr:CORR,errlog:ELOG});
  return `<div class="pov"><div class="psh"><h2>記録の保存・読込</h2>${SYNCOK?'<div class="syncok">☁ この記録はClaudeのアカウントに自動で同期されています（スマホとPCで共通）</div>':''}<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--sub);line-height:1.7">◎○△・メモ・まちがい回数は、このブラウザに自動保存されます。別の端末に移すときは、下の文字列をコピーして、移し先で貼り付けて読み込んでください。</div>
    <div class="k3">この端末の記録</div><textarea class="cfgta" id="cfgout" readonly>${esc(data)}</textarea><div class="acts" style="justify-content:flex-start;margin-top:6px"><button class="sb" data-a="cfgcopy">コピー</button></div>
    <div class="k3">別の端末の記録を読み込む</div><textarea class="cfgta" id="cfgin" placeholder="ここに貼り付け"></textarea>
    <div class="msg">${esc(CFGMSG)}</div><div class="acts"><button class="sb" data-a="cfgclose">閉じる</button><button class="pbtn" data-a="cfgload">読み込む</button></div>
    <div class="k3" style="margin-top:14px">英作文のAI添削</div><div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--sub);line-height:1.7">${SAMPLE?'Claudeの画面で開いているので、APIキーなしでアプリの中で添削できます。以下はファイル版で使うときの設定です。<br>':''}APIキーがなくても、「添削する」を押すとClaudeの画面が開いて添削できます。Anthropic の APIキー（console.anthropic.com で発行・使った分だけ料金）を入れると、結果がこのアプリの中に表示されて保存されます。キーはこのブラウザの中にだけ保存されます。</div>
    <input class="cfgin" id="aikey" type="password" autocomplete="off" placeholder="APIキー（sk-ant-…）" value="${esc(AICFG.key||'')}">
    <input class="cfgin" id="aimodel" placeholder="モデル名（空欄なら ${AIDEF}）" value="${esc(AICFG.model||'')}">
    <div class="acts" style="justify-content:flex-start"><button class="sb" data-a="aisave">保存</button>${AICFG.key?'<button class="sb" data-a="aidel">キーを消す</button>':''}</div></div></div>`}
let FLAT=null;
function buildFlat(){FLAT=[];D.tabs.forEach((t,ti)=>(t.hidden?[]:t.secs).forEach((s,si)=>s.items.forEach(it=>{
  if(it.k==='fam')it.s.forEach(x=>{if(!x.ref)FLAT.push({ti,si,it:{k:'fam',no:it.no,h:it.h,s:[x]},txt:(x.f+' '+x.m+' '+JSON.stringify(x.alt||'')).toLowerCase()})});
  else if(CARDK.has(it.k))FLAT.push({ti,si,it,txt:JSON.stringify(it).replace(/\[\[|\]\]|\{\{|\}\}|⟦|⟧|\*\*/g,'').toLowerCase()})})))}
function searchHTML(){
  if(!FLAT)buildFlat();const q=Q.toLowerCase(),hits=FLAT.filter(x=>x.txt.includes(q));
  let h=`<div class="pt" style="margin:0 2px 6px"><span>「${esc(Q)}」 ${fmtN(hits.length)}件${hits.length>150?'（先頭150件）':''}</span></div>`;
  let last='';hits.slice(0,150).forEach(x=>{const t=D.tabs[x.ti],lab=t.name+'｜'+t.secs[x.si].t;h+=renderList(lab!==last?[{k:'h',t:lab},x.it]:[x.it]);last=lab});
  return h;
}
function draw(keep){
  const y=scrollY;
  let h=header();
  if(ST.srch&&Q)h+=`<div id="list">${searchHTML()}</div>`;
  else h+=ST.view==='home'?homeHTML():ST.view==='errs'?errsHTML():ST.view==='kako'?kakoHTML():tabHTML();
  if(PROPEN)h+=prSheet();
  if(CFG)h+=cfgHTML();
  if(BACK&&ST.view==='tab')h+=`<button class="backpill" data-a="back">‹ 元の場所に戻る</button>`;
  if(ST.view==='tab'&&!(ST.srch&&Q))document.body.dataset.cat=D.tabs[ST.tab].id;else delete document.body.dataset.cat;
  app.innerHTML=h;save();
  if(keep)scrollTo(0,y);
  else{const on=document.querySelector('.rchip.on');if(on){const bar=on.parentNode;bar.scrollLeft=on.offsetLeft-bar.clientWidth/2+on.offsetWidth/2}}
}
function redrawList(){const el=document.getElementById('list');if(!el)return draw(true);if(ST.mode==='drill'&&!(ST.srch&&Q)){el.innerHTML=drillHTML();return}
  el.innerHTML=(ST.srch&&Q)?searchHTML():(renderList(curItems())||'<div class="empty">この条件の項目はありません</div>')}
function redrawCard(){const el=document.getElementById('cardbox');if(el)el.innerHTML=ST.mode==='quiz'?quizHTML():cardHTML()}
function jump(u){const h=HOMEU[u];if(!h)return;BACK={tab:ST.tab,sec:ST.sec,y:scrollY};
  ST.view='tab';ST.tab=h[0];ST.sec=h[1];ST.mode='list';ST.mf='all';ST.sf='all';ST.srch=false;Q='';TG={};OPEN={};FC=null;QZ=null;draw();
  const b=document.querySelector(`.mk[data-u="${u}"]`);const row=b&&b.closest('.wr,.br');
  if(row){row.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});row.classList.add('flash');setTimeout(()=>row.classList.remove('flash'),1800)}}
function goSec(i){ST.sec=i;ST.rf=null;ST.msel=ST.mm?[i]:null;TG={};OPEN={};FC=null;QZ=null;draw();scrollTo(0,0)}
function grade(g){const x=FC.deck[FC.i];setMark(x.u,g,false);FC.res[g]++;FC.i++;FC.flip=false;redrawCard()}

app.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(typeof kakoClick==='function'&&kakoClick(e))return;
  const stcal=e.target.closest('[data-stcal]');
  if(stcal){const [action,id]=stcal.dataset.stcal.split(':');
    if(action==='toggle')STCAL.open[id]=!STCAL.open[id];
    else{const [year,month]=((STCAL.month[id]||ymd(new Date()).slice(0,7)).split('-')).map(Number);STCAL.month[id]=ymd(new Date(year,month-1+(action==='next'?1:-1),1)).slice(0,7)}
    LS.set('mt-study-calendar-ui-v1',STCAL);draw(true);return}
  const pronunciationRetry=e.target.closest('[data-pron-retry]');
  if(pronunciationRetry){const key=pronunciationRetry.dataset.pronRetry;PRON_FAILURES.delete(key);requestPron(key);pronunciationRetry.outerHTML=pronMarkup(key);return}
  const mk=e.target.closest('.mk');
  if(mk){const u=mk.dataset.u,m=+mk.dataset.m;setMark(u,m,true);
    const row=mk.closest('.wr,.br');mk.parentNode.querySelectorAll('.mk').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('sel',MK[u]===+b.dataset.m));
    if(row){row.classList.remove('m1','m2','m3');if(MK[u])row.classList.add('m'+MK[u])}return}
  if(e.target.closest('textarea'))return;
  const pen=e.target.closest('[data-pen]');if(pen){const u=pen.dataset.pen;EDIT[u]=!EDIT[u];redrawList();if(EDIT[u]){const ta=document.querySelector(`textarea[data-memo="${u}"]`);if(ta)ta.focus()}return}
  const ch=e.target.closest('[data-ch]');if(ch){FC.ord.push(+ch.dataset.ch);redrawCard();return}
  const chr=e.target.closest('[data-chr]');if(chr){FC.ord.splice(+chr.dataset.chr,1);redrawCard();return}
  const ag=e.target.closest('[data-aigo]');if(ag){aiCorrect(ag.dataset.aigo);return}
  if(e.target.closest('.noflip'))return;
  const qo=e.target.closest('[data-qo]');if(qo&&QZ&&QZ.pick===null){QZ.pick=+qo.dataset.qo;const x=QZ.deck[QZ.i];if(QZ.opts[QZ.pick].u===x.u)QZ.ok++;else{QZ.ng.push(x);setMark(x.u,3,false)}redrawCard();return}
  const qg=e.target.closest('[data-qg]');if(qg){const x=QZ.deck[QZ.i];setMark(x.u,+qg.dataset.qg,false);QZ.i++;QZ.pick=null;QZ.opts=null;redrawCard();return}
  const ds=e.target.closest('[data-dsc]');if(ds){ST.dsc=ds.dataset.dsc;draw(true);return}
  const cm=e.target.closest('[data-cpm]');if(cm){ST.cpm=cm.dataset.cpm;if(FC){FC.pool=null}draw(true);return}
  const j=e.target.closest('[data-j]');if(j){jump(+j.dataset.j);return}
  if(e.target.closest('[data-a="back"]')){const b=BACK;BACK=null;ST.view='tab';ST.tab=b.tab;ST.sec=b.sec;TG={};OPEN={};FC=null;QZ=null;draw();scrollTo(0,b.y);return}
  const k2=e.target.closest('[data-kk]');if(k2){const k=k2.dataset.kk;OKK[k]=!OKK[k];redrawList();return}
  const kk=e.target.closest('[data-k]');if(kk){const u=kk.dataset.k;TGK[u]=!TGK[u];redrawList();return}
  const t=e.target.closest('[data-t]');if(t){const u=t.dataset.t;TG[u]=!TG[u];redrawList();return}
  const ai=e.target.closest('[data-ai]');if(ai){const u=ai.dataset.ai,cur=AIO[u]!=null?AIO[u]:!!(ESS[u]||CORR[u]);AIO[u]=!cur;redrawList();if(AIO[u]){const ta=document.querySelector(`textarea[data-ess="${u}"]`);if(ta)ta.focus()}return}
  const ac=e.target.closest('[data-aiclr]');if(ac){delete CORR[ac.dataset.aiclr];LS.set('mt-corr',CORR);redrawList();return}
  const ef=e.target.closest('[data-ef]');if(ef){const [k,v]=ef.dataset.ef.split(':');EF[k]=v;draw(true);return}
  const ed=e.target.closest('[data-edone]');if(ed){const x=ELOG.find(y=>y.id===ed.dataset.edone);if(x){x.done=!x.done;LS.set('mt-errlog',ELOG)}draw(true);return}
  const el2=e.target.closest('[data-edel]');if(el2){ELOG=ELOG.filter(y=>y.id!==el2.dataset.edel);LS.set('mt-errlog',ELOG);draw(true);return}
  const nf=e.target.closest('[data-inf]');if(nf){const k=nf.dataset.inf;INF[k]=!INF[k];redrawList();return}
  const o=e.target.closest('[data-o]');if(o){const u=o.dataset.o;OPEN[u]=!OPEN[u];redrawList();return}
  const pm=e.target.closest('[data-pmode]');if(pm){const [id,mode]=pm.dataset.pmode.split(':');PLAN.mode[id]=mode;LS.set('mt-plan',PLAN);draw(true);return}
  const tb=e.target.closest('[data-tab]');if(tb&&e.target.closest('.bkplan'))return;if(tb){ST.view='tab';ST.tab=+tb.dataset.tab;ST.sec=0;ST.sf='all';ST.msel=null;ST.rf=null;ST.kata=false;TG={};OPEN={};FC=null;QZ=null;Q='';ST.srch=false;draw();scrollTo(0,0);return}
  const sc=e.target.closest('[data-sec]');if(sc){const i=+sc.dataset.sec;
    if(canMulti()&&ST.mm){let m=curSecs().slice();if(m.includes(i)){if(m.length>1)m=m.filter(x=>x!==i)}else m.push(i);ST.msel=m;ST.sec=Math.min(...m);TG={};OPEN={};FC=null;QZ=null;draw(true);return}
    goSec(i);return}
  const g2=e.target.closest('[data-g2]');if(g2){ST.msel=null;const i=D.tabs[ST.tab].secs.findIndex(x=>x.g===g2.dataset.g2);if(i>=0)goSec(i);return}
  const md=e.target.closest('[data-mode]');if(md){ST.mode=md.dataset.mode;ST.kata=false;FC=null;QZ=null;draw(true);return}
  if(e.target.closest('[data-a="pron-toggle"]')){PRON_VISIBLE=!PRON_VISIBLE;LS.set('mt-pronunciation-visible',PRON_VISIBLE);draw(true);return}
  const mf=e.target.closest('[data-mf]');if(mf){ST.mf=mf.dataset.mf;FC=null;QZ=null;draw(true);return}
  const g=e.target.closest('[data-g]');if(g&&!g.disabled){grade(+g.dataset.g);return}
  if(e.target.classList.contains('pov')){PROPEN=false;CFG=false;draw(true);return}
  const pr=e.target.closest('[data-pr]');if(pr){const [k,v]=pr.dataset.pr.split(':');PR[k]=v;draw(true);return}
  const a=e.target.closest('[data-a]');if(!a)return;
  const act=a.dataset.a,T=D.tabs[ST.tab];
  if(act==='home'){BACK=null;ST.view='home';ST.srch=false;Q='';draw();scrollTo(0,0)}
  else if(act==='kako'){BACK=null;ST.view='kako';ST.srch=false;Q='';draw();scrollTo(0,0)}
  else if(act==='cont'){ST.view='tab';draw();scrollTo(0,0)}
  else if(act==='srch'){ST.srch=!ST.srch;if(!ST.srch)Q='';draw(true);const q=document.getElementById('q');if(q)q.focus()}
  else if(act==='show'){ST.show=!ST.show;if(!isG())ST.showK=ST.show;TG={};TGK={};OKK={};draw(true)}
  else if(act==='hans'){ST.hideAns=!ST.hideAns;TG={};draw(true)}
  else if(act==='hexp'){ST.hideExp=!ST.hideExp;TG={};draw(true)}
  else if(act==='oall'){ST.openAll=!ST.openAll;OPEN={};draw(true)}
  else if(act==='showk'){ST.showK=!ST.showK;TGK={};OKK={};draw(true)}
  else if(act==='katachi'){ST.mode='card';ST.dir='j';ST.kata=true;FC=null;QZ=null;draw()}
  else if(act==='qnext'){QZ.i++;QZ.pick=null;QZ.opts=null;redrawCard()}
  else if(act==='qagain'){buildQuiz();redrawCard()}
  else if(act==='qweak'){QZ={deck:QZ.ng,i:0,pick:null,opts:null,ok:0,ng:[]};redrawCard()}
  else if(act==='cfg'){CFG=true;CFGMSG='';draw(true)}
  else if(act==='cfgclose'){CFG=false;draw(true)}
  else if(act==='cfgcopy'){const ta=document.getElementById('cfgout');const done=()=>{CFGMSG='コピーしました';const m=document.querySelector('.psh .msg');if(m)m.textContent=CFGMSG};try{navigator.clipboard.writeText(ta.value).then(done,()=>{ta.select();CFGMSG='選択しました。長押しでコピーしてください';const m=document.querySelector('.psh .msg');if(m)m.textContent=CFGMSG})}catch(_){ta.select()}}
  else if(act==='aisave'){AICFG={key:document.getElementById('aikey').value.trim(),model:document.getElementById('aimodel').value.trim()};LS.set('mt-ai',AICFG);CFGMSG='AI添削の設定を保存しました';draw(true)}
  else if(act==='aidel'){AICFG={key:'',model:AICFG.model||''};LS.set('mt-ai',AICFG);CFGMSG='APIキーを消しました';draw(true)}
  else if(act==='cfgload'){try{const o=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('cfgin').value);if(!o||!o.marks)throw 0;MK=o.marks;MEMO=o.memo||{};MISS=o.miss||{};HIST=o.hist||HIST;DAYACT=normalizeDayActivity(o.study||DAYACT);if(o.essay){ESS=o.essay;LS.set('mt-essay',ESS)}if(o.corr){CORR=o.corr;LS.set('mt-corr',CORR)}if(o.errlog){ELOG=o.errlog;LS.set('mt-errlog',ELOG)}LS.set('mt-marks',MK);LS.set('mt-memo',MEMO);LS.set('mt-miss',MISS);LS.set('mt-hist',HIST);LS.set('mt-day-activity-v1',DAYACT);CFGMSG='読み込みました（◎○△ '+Object.keys(MK).length+'件）';}catch(_){CFGMSG='読み込めませんでした。コピーした文字列をそのまま貼り付けてください'}draw(true)}
  else if(act==='dir'){ST.dir=ST.dir==='j'?'f':'j';TG={};if(FC)FC.flip=false;draw(true)}
  else if(act==='print'){if(!prNumBounds(T,T.secs[ST.sec]))PR.scope='sec';PR.a='';PR.b='';PROPEN=true;draw(true)}
  else if(act==='prclose'){PROPEN=false;draw(true)}
  else if(act==='prgo'){doPrint()}
  else if(act==='shuf'){ST.shuf=!ST.shuf;RK=new WeakMap();FC=null;QZ=null;if(typeof DORD!=='undefined')for(const k in DORD)delete DORD[k];draw(true)}
  else if(act==='reshuf'){RK=new WeakMap();FC=null;QZ=null;if(typeof DORD!=='undefined')for(const k in DORD)delete DORD[k];draw(true)}
  else if(act==='errs'){BACK=null;ST.view='errs';ST.srch=false;Q='';draw();scrollTo(0,0)}
  else if(act==='efdone'){EF.done=!EF.done;draw(true)}
  else if(act==='tmr'){TM.open=true;tmRender()}
  else if(act==='rfclr'){ST.rf=null;FC=null;QZ=null;draw(true)}
  else if(act==='mm'){ST.mm=!ST.mm;ST.msel=ST.mm?[ST.sec]:null;FC=null;QZ=null;draw(true)}
  else if(act==='mmall'){const g=T.secs[ST.sec].g;ST.msel=T.secs.map((x,i)=>x.g===g&&SECU[ST.tab][i].length?i:-1).filter(i=>i>=0);ST.sec=ST.msel[0];FC=null;QZ=null;draw(true)}
  else if(act==='prev'&&ST.sec>0)goSec(ST.sec-1);
  else if(act==='next'&&ST.sec<T.secs.length-1)goSec(ST.sec+1);
  else if(act==='flip'){FC.flip=!FC.flip;redrawCard()}
  else if(act==='prevc'){FC.i=Math.max(0,FC.i-1);FC.flip=false;redrawCard()}
  else if(act==='skip'){FC.i++;FC.flip=false;redrawCard()}
  else if(act==='again'){buildDeck();redrawCard()}
  else if(act==='weak'){FC.deck=FC.deck.filter(x=>MK[x.u]===2||MK[x.u]===3);FC.i=0;FC.flip=false;FC.res={1:0,2:0,3:0};redrawCard()}
});
app.addEventListener('change',e=>{const ds=e.target.dataset||{};
  if(ds.pend!=null){PLAN.end[ds.pend]=e.target.value;LS.set('mt-plan',PLAN);draw(true);return}
  if(ds.pstart!=null){PLAN.start[ds.pstart]=e.target.value;LS.set('mt-plan',PLAN);draw(true);return}
  if(ds.pdaily!=null){const v=Number(e.target.value);if(e.target.value!==''&&Number.isFinite(v)&&v>0)PLAN.daily[ds.pdaily]=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(v));LS.set('mt-plan',PLAN);draw(true);return}
if(e.target.matches&&e.target.matches('select[data-sf]')){ST.sf=e.target.value;FC=null;QZ=null;draw(true)}}); 
let rft;let qt;app.addEventListener('input',e=>{
  if(e.target.dataset&&e.target.dataset.prnum){PR[e.target.dataset.prnum]=e.target.value;return}
  if(e.target.dataset&&e.target.dataset.rf){const k=e.target.dataset.rf,v=e.target.value;clearTimeout(rft);rft=setTimeout(()=>{const gv=x=>{const el=document.querySelector(`input[data-rf="${x}"]`);const s=el?el.value:'';return s?Math.max(1,parseInt(s)||1):''};ST.rf={a:gv('a'),b:gv('b')};FC=null;QZ=null;
    if(ST.mode==='list'&&document.getElementById('list')){redrawList();const bx=document.querySelector('.rfbox');if(bx)bx.classList.toggle('on',!!rfOn())}else{draw(true);const el=document.querySelector(`input[data-rf="${k}"]`);if(el)el.focus()}},500);return}
  if(e.target.dataset&&e.target.dataset.ess){const u=e.target.dataset.ess;if(e.target.value)ESS[u]=e.target.value;else delete ESS[u];LS.set('mt-essay',ESS);return}
  if(e.target.dataset&&e.target.dataset.memo){const u=e.target.dataset.memo;if(e.target.value)MEMO[u]=e.target.value;else delete MEMO[u];LS.set('mt-memo',MEMO);return}
  if(e.target.dataset&&e.target.dataset.cw){const u=e.target.dataset.cw;WR[u]=e.target.value;if(e.target.value)ESS[u]=e.target.value;else delete ESS[u];LS.set('mt-essay',ESS);return}
  if(e.target.id!=='q')return;clearTimeout(qt);qt=setTimeout(()=>{
  const nq=e.target.value.trim();
  if(!!nq!==!!Q){Q=nq;const pos=e.target.selectionStart;draw(true);const q=document.getElementById('q');if(q){q.focus();try{q.setSelectionRange(pos,pos)}catch(_){}}}
  else{Q=nq;if(Q)redrawList()}},300)});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(ST.view!=='tab'||ST.mode!=='card'||!FC||e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('textarea')||/INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA/.test(e.target.tagName))return;
  if(e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();if(FC.i<FC.deck.length){FC.flip=!FC.flip;redrawCard()}}
  else if(FC.flip&&['1','2','3'].includes(e.key))grade(+e.key);
  else if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){FC.i=Math.min(FC.deck.length,FC.i+1);FC.flip=false;redrawCard()}
  else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){FC.i=Math.max(0,FC.i-1);FC.flip=false;redrawCard()}
});
trackHist();draw();
// ---------- クラウド同期（Claudeで開いたとき：スマホとPCで記録を共通に） ----------
let SDB=null,SUID=null,SAMPLE=null,SYNCOK=false;const SKEYS=['mt-kkdone','mt-plan','mt-marks','mt-memo','mt-miss','mt-hist','mt-day-activity-v1','mt-essay','mt-corr','mt-errlog'];
const SSET={'mt-plan':v=>{PLAN=Object.assign({end:{},mpi:{},base:{}},v);planDefaults()},'mt-marks':v=>MK=v,'mt-memo':v=>MEMO=v,'mt-miss':v=>MISS=v,'mt-hist':v=>HIST=v,'mt-day-activity-v1':v=>DAYACT=normalizeDayActivity(v),'mt-essay':v=>ESS=v,'mt-corr':v=>CORR=v,'mt-errlog':v=>ELOG=v};
const SGET={'mt-plan':()=>PLAN,'mt-marks':()=>MK,'mt-memo':()=>MEMO,'mt-miss':()=>MISS,'mt-hist':()=>HIST,'mt-day-activity-v1':()=>DAYACT,'mt-essay':()=>ESS,'mt-corr':()=>CORR,'mt-errlog':()=>ELOG};
let SAT={};try{SAT=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mt-sync-at'))||{}}catch(_){}
const saveSAT=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('mt-sync-at',JSON.stringify(SAT))}catch(_){}};
const STM={},SBUSY={},SDIRTY={};
function syncTouch(k){if(!SKEYS.includes(k))return;SAT[k]=Date.now();saveSAT();if(!SYNCOK)return;clearTimeout(STM[k]);STM[k]=setTimeout(()=>syncPush(k),1500)}
const sbase=()=>'data/users/'+SUID;
async function syncPush(k){if(!SYNCOK)return;if(SBUSY[k]){SDIRTY[k]=1;return}SBUSY[k]=1;
  try{const s=JSON.stringify(SGET[k]()||{}),CH=60000,n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(s.length/CH)),at=SAT[k]||Date.now();
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++)await SDB.doc(sbase()+'/'+k+'.'+i).set({s:s.slice(i*CH,(i+1)*CH),at});
    await SDB.doc(sbase()+'/'+k).set({at,n})}catch(e){console.warn('sync push',k,e&&e.code)}
  SBUSY[k]=0;if(SDIRTY[k]){SDIRTY[k]=0;syncPush(k)}}
async function syncPull(){if(!SYNCOK)return;let changed=false;
  for(const k of SKEYS){try{const m=await SDB.doc(sbase()+'/'+k).get();
      if(m.exists){const d=m.data(),ra=+d.at||0,la=+SAT[k]||0;
        if(ra>la){let s='';for(let i=0;i<(+d.n||1);i++){const p=await SDB.doc(sbase()+'/'+k+'.'+i).get();if(!p.exists||+p.data().at!==ra)throw {code:'partial'};s+=p.data().s}
          const v=JSON.parse(s);SSET[k](v);try{localStorage.setItem(k,s)}catch(_){}SAT[k]=ra;saveSAT();changed=true}
        else if(la>ra)syncPush(k)}
      else if(SAT[k]||Object.keys(SGET[k]()||{}).length){if(!SAT[k]){SAT[k]=Date.now();saveSAT()}syncPush(k)}}
    catch(e){console.warn('sync pull',k,e&&e.code)}}
  if(changed){FLAT=null;FC=null;QZ=null;if(!(document.activeElement&&/TEXTAREA|INPUT/.test(document.activeElement.tagName)))draw(true)}}
(async()=>{if(!window.claude||!window.claude.use)return;
  try{const [db,user,smp]=await Promise.all([claude.use('db'),claude.use('user'),claude.use('sample')]);SAMPLE=smp||null;
    if(db&&user){const id=await user.id();if(id){SDB=db;SUID=id;SYNCOK=true;await syncPull();if(CFG)draw(true)}}}catch(e){console.warn('sync init',e)}
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.visibilityState==='visible')syncPull()})})();
</script>

</body></html>
